cases.expected: a non‑null SchemaLoader instance that is the same object stored inside the factory
cases.description: When a factory is created via the default `JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V201909)` call, `getSchemaLoader()` should return the internal `schemaLoader` field. The returned reference must be non‑null and identical (==) to the loader used by the factory.

cases.expected: the custom SchemaLoader instance supplied through the Builder
cases.description: Using `JsonSchemaFactory.builder()` a custom `SchemaLoader` (e.g., a mock or a `DefaultSchemaLoader` with a stubbed resolver) is injected via the builder’s `schemaLoader` method. After building the factory, `getSchemaLoader()` must return exactly that custom instance, confirming the getter does not create a new object.

cases.expected: the same SchemaLoader instance on successive calls
cases.description: For any created factory (default or custom), invoking `getSchemaLoader()` multiple times must return the identical object each time, proving the method is a simple accessor without side‑effects.

cases.expected: Two factories created via `JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V201909)` must have different `SchemaLoader` objects (loader1 != loader2)
cases.description: Ensures that the factory does not use a global singleton `SchemaLoader`; each factory instance should own its own loader.

cases.expected: The `SchemaLoader` returned before and after calling any `getSchema(...)` overload remains the identical object (loaderBefore == loaderAfter)
cases.description: Verifies that invoking other public methods of the factory does not replace or re‑initialize the internal `schemaLoader`.

cases.expected: When a custom `SchemaLoader` subclass (e.g., `MySchemaLoader`) is supplied through the builder, `getSchemaLoader()` returns an instance of that exact subclass
cases.description: Checks that the getter does not cast or wrap the supplied loader and that the runtime type is preserved.

cases.expected: Concurrent invocations of `getSchemaLoader()` from multiple threads all return the same reference (all == the loader stored in the factory)
cases.description: Tests thread‑safety of the accessor; even under parallel calls the factory must not create additional loader instances.
